[AI engineering](../index.qmd) / Production and inference

Make the system reliable, observable and economical under real use.

## What to understand

- **Service design:** async work, queues, timeouts, cancellation, backpressure and bounded retries.
- **Performance:** time to first token, total task latency, p50/p95, caching, batching and parallel work.
- **Economics:** per-task cost, token use, tool costs and quality-aware model routing.
- **Observability:** traces, structured logs, model/prompt/tool versions and redacted records for debugging.
- **Deployment:** reproducible builds, CI checks, rollout, rollback and deprecation monitoring.
- **Open-model serving:** GPU memory, quantization, batching, vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp and operational ownership.
- **Monitoring:** failure rates, quality drift, incidents and user feedback—not only uptime.

## How the pieces connect

A model benchmark is only one component of system performance. Retrieval, tools, retries and UI rendering all affect the user’s wait.

## A question to test

Instrument one end-to-end task. Record quality, cost, first-output latency and completion time; test a tool outage and demonstrate recovery.
